name: @superinstance/quilt-neighbourhood
description: Diff-DAG convergence for Quilt sheets — replicas partition, diverge, and rejoin to one deterministic revision. v0.6.0 adds DID-signed reconciliation events (P8 x P6): a did-authored event MUST carry a valid Ed25519 signature over its event id or applyReconciliation refuses; signed sheets accept DID-signed events (Q2 resolved); emitter-side createReconciliation(privateKey) signs event + marker + rec-diffs for signed transport.
